```{=html}
<div style="border:1px solid #ccc; border-left:4px solid #2E86AB; padding:12px 14px; margin:1rem 0; background:#fafafa;">
<strong>How to read this report</strong>
<ul style="margin-bottom:0;">
<li><strong>Burden-style interpretation</strong> (effect direction, OR, volcano, CHEK2, directional gene lists) uses <code>TEST == &quot;ADD&quot;</code> only.</li>
<li><strong>FDR</strong> (<code>PVAL_ADJ</code>) is Benjamini–Hochberg <em>within family</em>: ADD alone; SKAT+SKATO together. Do not mix with the other family’s FDR.</li>
<li><strong>SKAT / SKATO</strong> are non-directional (no risk/protective OR). Use the separate SKAT/SKATO export — not the ADD tables.</li>
<li>Exports: all-tests archive, ADD-only, and SKAT/SKATO-only (no BETA/OR columns).</li>
</ul>
</div>
```

<!-- 
NOTES TO SELF:

- M1 = pathogenic variants only (LoF level 1)
- M2 = VUS variants only (LoF level 2) 
- M3 = pathogenic + VUS variants combined
- M4 = synonymous negative-control variants (excluding LoF 1/2 and excluding blacklisted potential MNP-pair IDs)
- Gene×consequence exclude (preprocess): CHEK2 missense_variant dropped from all masks (literature: CHEK2 missense not disease-contributing here)
- ADD = additive burden test (BETA/SE/OR and directional interpretation apply here only)
- ADD-SKAT / ADD-SKATO = variance-component tests (non-directional; separate export; no BETA/OR interpretation)
- FDR (PVAL_ADJ): BH within ADD; separately BH within SKAT+SKATO combined
- Exome-wide significance = p < 2.5e-6 (not GWAS 5e-8)
- Lambda GC less interpretable in ExWAS due to sparse rare variants

KEY TERMS:

- BETA (Effect Size): Log odds ratio of disease association for alt allele
  * Positive BETA = alt allele increases disease risk
  * Negative BETA = alt allele is protective
- SE (Standard Error): Uncertainty around effect size estimate
  * High SE = less confidence in BETA (common for rare variants)
- PVAL/LOG10P: p-value from association test
  * LOG10P = -log10(p-value) for plotting
  * Plots cap extreme -log10(p) at 100 where needed; CSVs keep raw LOG10P
  * Smaller p-values (larger LOG10P) = stronger evidence
- PVAL_ADJ/FDR: False discovery rate-adjusted p-values (Benjamini-Hochberg)
  * Controls for multiple testing across thousands of variants/genes
  * Prevents false positives from testing many hypotheses
-->


```{r setup,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggrepel)
library(qqman)
library(DiagrammeR)

# Set consistent theme
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 13))

# Genomic-control λ (Devlin & Roeder): median(χ²_1) / median(χ²_1 | null).
# χ² = qchisq(1 - p, df = 1). The null median is qchisq(0.5, 1) ≈ 0.4549.
# On a -log10(p) QQ this is the median test, near expected -log10(p) = 0.301.
.p_for_lambda <- function(log10p) {
  log10p <- as.numeric(log10p)
  log10p <- log10p[is.finite(log10p) & log10p >= 0]
  if (!length(log10p)) return(numeric())
  # 10^(-x) underflows to 0 past ~308; keep a tiny positive p so those tests stay in the set.
  10^(-pmin(log10p, 300))
}

.lambda_gc <- function(p) {
  p <- as.numeric(p)
  p <- p[is.finite(p) & p > 0 & p <= 1]
  if (length(p) < 10L) return(NA_real_)
  median(qchisq(1 - p, df = 1), na.rm = TRUE) / qchisq(0.5, df = 1)
}

.fmt_lambda <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.finite(x), sprintf("%.3f", x), "NA")
}

.qq_points <- function(log10p) {
  log10p <- as.numeric(log10p)
  log10p <- sort(log10p[is.finite(log10p) & log10p >= 0], decreasing = TRUE)
  n <- length(log10p)
  if (!n) return(tibble(expected = numeric(), observed = numeric(), exp_p = numeric()))
  exp_p <- ppoints(n)
  tibble(
    expected = -log10(exp_p),
    observed = log10p,
    exp_p = exp_p
  )
}

.qq_median_row <- function(qq) {
  if (!nrow(qq)) return(qq[0, , drop = FALSE])
  one <- function(d) d[which.min(abs(d$exp_p - 0.5)), , drop = FALSE]
  if ("facet_lab" %in% names(qq)) {
    return(bind_rows(lapply(split(qq, qq$facet_lab), one)))
  }
  one(qq)
}

.qq_lambda_curve <- function(n, lambda, n_grid = 250L) {
  if (!is.finite(lambda) || n < 10L) {
    return(tibble(expected = numeric(), observed = numeric()))
  }
  exp_p <- exp(seq(log(max(0.5 / n, 1e-300)), log(0.999), length.out = n_grid))
  chisq_null <- qchisq(1 - exp_p, df = 1)
  p_hat <- pchisq(lambda * chisq_null, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  tibble(
    expected = -log10(exp_p),
    observed = -log10(pmax(p_hat, 1e-300))
  )
}

.plot_qq <- function(qq, curve = NULL, med = NULL, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL) {
  lim <- max(c(qq$expected, qq$observed), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(lim) || lim < 1) lim <- 1
  if (is.null(xlim)) xlim <- c(0, lim)
  if (is.null(ylim)) ylim <- c(0, lim)
  p <- ggplot(qq, aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey35", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(size = 1.15, alpha = 0.45, color = "#2E86AB")
  if (!is.null(curve) && nrow(curve) > 0L) {
    p <- p + geom_line(data = curve, color = "#E07A3D", linewidth = 0.75)
  }
  if (!is.null(med) && nrow(med) > 0L) {
    p <- p + geom_point(data = med, shape = 18, size = 3.4, color = "black")
  }
  if ("facet_lab" %in% names(qq)) {
    p <- p + facet_wrap(~facet_lab, nrow = 1)
  }
  p +
    coord_equal(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim) +
    labs(
      x = expression(Expected ~ -log[10](p)),
      y = expression(Observed ~ -log[10](p)),
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle
    ) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}

# Shared HTML table look (gene col bold; consequence headers readable)
.fmt_consequence_label <- function(x) {
  # variant-list display: keep compound terms readable
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("&", " / ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}
.fmt_consequence_header <- function(x) {
  # matrix column headers: single terms, spaces not underscores
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x
}

.style_report_kable <- function(
  k,
  font_size = 12,
  full_width = TRUE,
  gene_col = 1L,
  scroll_h = NULL,
  header_wrap = FALSE
) {
  out <- kableExtra::kable_styling(
    k,
    full_width = full_width,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    font_size = font_size
  )
  if (!is.null(gene_col) && length(gene_col) && gene_col[1] > 0) {
    out <- kableExtra::column_spec(out, gene_col[1], bold = TRUE)
  }
  if (isTRUE(header_wrap)) {
    out <- kableExtra::row_spec(
      out, 0,
      align = "c",
      extra_css = paste(
        "vertical-align: middle;",
        "white-space: normal;",
        "line-height: 1.25;",
        "min-height: 4.2em;",
        "max-width: 8.5em;",
        "word-break: break-word;",
        "hyphens: auto;",
        "padding-top: 10px;",
        "padding-bottom: 10px;"
      )
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(scroll_h)) {
    out <- kableExtra::scroll_box(out, width = "100%", height = scroll_h)
  }
  out
}
```

```{r load-data,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
# Validate project name parameter
if(is.null(params$project_name) || params$project_name == "") {
  stop("ERROR: project_name parameter is required but was not provided or is empty. ",
       "Please specify params=list(project_name='YOUR_PROJECT_NAME') when rendering.")
}

# Load single variant data from all chromosomes
single_variant_list <- list()

for(i in 1:22) {
  file_path <- paste0("data/final/", params$project_name, ".chr", i, ".", params$step2_single_variant_mid, ".regenie")
  if(file.exists(file_path)) {
    single_variant_list[[i]] <- read_delim(file_path, delim = " ", col_names = TRUE, trim_ws = TRUE)
  }
}

# Combine all single variant data
single_variant <- bind_rows(single_variant_list) %>%
   mutate(across(c(CHROM, GENPOS, N, N_CASES, N_CONTROLS), as.integer),
         across(c(A1FREQ, A1FREQ_CASES, A1FREQ_CONTROLS, BETA, SE, CHISQ, LOG10P), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(CHROM = as.factor(CHROM)) %>% 
  arrange(CHROM, GENPOS) %>% 
  mutate(PVAL = 10^(-LOG10P),
         PVAL_ADJ = p.adjust(PVAL, method = "BH"),
         LOG10P_ADJ = -log10(PVAL_ADJ)) %>%
  mutate(POS_INDEX = row_number(),
         OR = exp(BETA)) %>%
  # Parse REF/ALT from trailing ID fields (…_POS_REF_ALT)
  mutate(
    REF = vapply(ID, function(x) {
      p <- strsplit(as.character(x), "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
      if (length(p) >= 4L) p[[length(p) - 1L]] else NA_character_
    }, character(1L)),
    ALT = vapply(ID, function(x) {
      p <- strsplit(as.character(x), "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
      if (length(p) >= 4L) p[[length(p)]] else NA_character_
    }, character(1L))
  )

# Thin pathogenic_vus / synonymous (small extracts only — do not load full VEP or full mask stats here)
pathogenic_vus_file <- paste0("data/final/", params$project_name, ".pathogenic_vus.csv")
if (file.exists(pathogenic_vus_file)) {
  pathogenic_annotations <- read_csv(pathogenic_vus_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  warning("Pathogenic/VUS annotation file not found.")
  pathogenic_annotations <- NULL
}

synonymous_file <- paste0("data/final/", params$project_name, ".synonymous.csv")
if (file.exists(synonymous_file)) {
  synonymous_annotations <- read_csv(synonymous_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  synonymous_annotations <- NULL
}

# Full mask stats may be ~700k rows (all mask sites). Never load whole file — subset by ID later.
.mask_stats_candidates <- c(
  file.path("data/regenie", "mask_variant_stats.tsv"),
  paste0("data/final/", params$project_name, ".mask_variant_stats.tsv")
)
.mask_stats_path <- .mask_stats_candidates[file.exists(.mask_stats_candidates)][1]
if (is.na(.mask_stats_path)) .mask_stats_path <- ""
if (nzchar(.mask_stats_path)) {
  message("Mask variant stats available (subset-on-demand): ", .mask_stats_path)
}

# Pull only needed ID rows from mask_variant_stats (data.table; no shell/awk)
.mask_stats_dt <- NULL
.id_aliases <- function(ids) {
  ids <- as.character(ids)
  out <- ids
  out <- c(out, ifelse(startsWith(ids, "chr"), substring(ids, 4L), paste0("chr", ids)))
  unique(out[nzchar(out) & !is.na(out)])
}
.stats_for_ids <- function(ids) {
  ids <- unique(as.character(ids))
  ids <- ids[nzchar(ids) & !is.na(ids)]
  if (!length(ids)) return(tibble())
  want <- .id_aliases(ids)

  if (nzchar(.mask_stats_path) && file.exists(.mask_stats_path)) {
    got <- tryCatch({
      if (is.null(.mask_stats_dt)) {
        .mask_stats_dt <<- data.table::fread(
          .mask_stats_path,
          sep = "\t",
          showProgress = FALSE,
          nThread = 1L
        )
        if (!"ID" %in% names(.mask_stats_dt)) {
          stop("mask_variant_stats.tsv missing ID column")
        }
        message("Loaded mask_variant_stats into memory: ", nrow(.mask_stats_dt), " rows")
      }
      sub <- .mask_stats_dt[ID %in% want]
      if (nrow(sub) == 0L) {
        tibble()
      } else {
        # remap stats ID back to the query ID form used by the caller
        alias_to_query <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
        for (q in ids) {
          for (a in .id_aliases(q)) assign(a, q, envir = alias_to_query)
        }
        sub <- tibble::as_tibble(sub)
        sub$ID <- vapply(as.character(sub$ID), function(a) {
          if (exists(a, envir = alias_to_query, inherits = FALSE)) get(a, envir = alias_to_query) else a
        }, character(1))
        distinct(sub, ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("mask_stats subset failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(got) && nrow(got) > 0) return(got)
  }

  # fallback: thin pathogenic/synonymous extracts
  bits <- list()
  if (!is.null(pathogenic_annotations) && nrow(pathogenic_annotations) > 0) {
    bits[[length(bits) + 1L]] <- pathogenic_annotations %>% filter(ID %in% want)
  }
  if (!is.null(synonymous_annotations) && nrow(synonymous_annotations) > 0) {
    bits[[length(bits) + 1L]] <- synonymous_annotations %>% filter(ID %in% want)
  }
  if (!length(bits)) return(tibble(ID = character()))
  bind_rows(bits) %>% distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

.join_gene_carriers <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(report_gene_carriers) || nrow(report_gene_carriers) == 0L) {
    return(df %>% mutate(Cases = NA_integer_, Controls = NA_integer_))
  }
  carr <- report_gene_carriers %>%
    select(GENE, MASK, THRESH, Cases = n_case_carriers, Controls = n_control_carriers)
  df %>% left_join(carr, by = c("GENE", "MASK", "THRESH"))
}

.fill_variant_carriers_from_afcc <- function(df) {
  # Rare-variant approx: alt allele count ≈ carrier count when mostly heterozygous
  if (!all(c("A1FREQ_CASES", "A1FREQ_CONTROLS", "N_CASES", "N_CONTROLS") %in% names(df))) {
    return(df)
  }
  if (!"n_case_carrier" %in% names(df)) df$n_case_carrier <- NA_real_
  if (!"n_control_carrier" %in% names(df)) df$n_control_carrier <- NA_real_
  df %>%
    mutate(
      n_case_carrier = if_else(
        is.na(n_case_carrier) & is.finite(A1FREQ_CASES) & is.finite(N_CASES),
        as.integer(round(A1FREQ_CASES * 2 * N_CASES)),
        as.integer(n_case_carrier)
      ),
      n_control_carrier = if_else(
        is.na(n_control_carrier) & is.finite(A1FREQ_CONTROLS) & is.finite(N_CONTROLS),
        as.integer(round(A1FREQ_CONTROLS * 2 * N_CONTROLS)),
        as.integer(n_control_carrier)
      )
    )
}

# Prebuilt slim tables from regenie_build_report_tables.py — required
.report_prefix <- paste0("data/final/", params$project_name, ".report")
.pre_top_fp <- paste0(.report_prefix, ".top_genes_ADD.tsv")
.pre_skat_fp <- paste0(.report_prefix, ".top_genes_SKAT.tsv")
.pre_contrib_fp <- paste0(.report_prefix, ".variant_contrib.tsv")
.pre_cons_fp <- paste0(.report_prefix, ".consequence_matrix.tsv")
.pre_carr_fp <- paste0(.report_prefix, ".gene_carriers.tsv")
.pre_chek2_carr_fp <- paste0(.report_prefix, ".chek2_carriers.tsv")
.required_report_files <- c(
  .pre_top_fp, .pre_skat_fp, .pre_contrib_fp, .pre_cons_fp,
  .pre_carr_fp, .pre_chek2_carr_fp
)
.missing_report <- .required_report_files[!file.exists(.required_report_files)]
if (length(.missing_report)) {
  stop(
    "Missing required prebuilt report tables. Run regenie_build_report_tables.py (Snakemake rule build_regenie_report_tables) first.\n",
    paste(" -", .missing_report, collapse = "\n")
  )
}
report_top_genes <- read_tsv(.pre_top_fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
report_top_skat <- read_tsv(.pre_skat_fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
report_contrib <- read_tsv(.pre_contrib_fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
report_consequence <- read_tsv(.pre_cons_fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
report_gene_carriers <- read_tsv(.pre_carr_fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
report_chek2_carriers <- read_tsv(.pre_chek2_carr_fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
message("Loaded prebuilt report tables: ", .report_prefix, ".*")

# Snplist not needed when prebuilt contrib/consequence tables are present
mask_snplist <- tibble(
  mask_id = character(), ID = character(),
  GENE = character(), MASK = character(), THRESH = character()
)
message("Skipping full snplist load (using prebuilt report tables)")

# OR 95% CI from BETA ± 1.96*SE
.add_or_ci <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      OR_L95 = if_else(is.finite(BETA) & is.finite(SE), exp(BETA - 1.96 * SE), NA_real_),
      OR_U95 = if_else(is.finite(BETA) & is.finite(SE), exp(BETA + 1.96 * SE), NA_real_)
    )
}
single_variant <- .add_or_ci(single_variant)

# Load gene-based data from all chromosomes
gene_based_list <- list()

for(i in 1:22) {
  file_path <- paste0("data/final/", params$project_name, ".chr", i, ".", params$step2_gene_based_mid, ".regenie")
  if(file.exists(file_path)) {
    # Skip comment lines (e.g. "# Regenie step 2") so header is CHROM GENPOS ... BETA ...; wrong skip misaligns BETA.
    gene_based_list[[i]] <- read_delim(file_path, delim = " ", col_names = TRUE, trim_ws = TRUE, comment = "#")
  }
}

# Combine all gene-based rows (all TEST types) — FDR applied within family below
gene_based_all <- bind_rows(gene_based_list) %>%
  mutate(across(c(CHROM, GENPOS, N, N_CASES, N_CONTROLS), as.integer),
         across(c(A1FREQ, A1FREQ_CASES, A1FREQ_CONTROLS, BETA, SE, CHISQ, LOG10P), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(CHROM = as.factor(CHROM),
         PVAL = 10^(-LOG10P)) %>%
  # OR only meaningful for additive burden (ADD)
  mutate(OR = if_else(TEST == "ADD" & is.finite(BETA), exp(BETA), NA_real_))

if(any(is.na(gene_based_all$LOG10P))) {
  warning(sprintf("Warning: %d gene-based tests have NA LOG10P values", sum(is.na(gene_based_all$LOG10P))))
}
if(any(is.infinite(gene_based_all$LOG10P))) {
  warning(sprintf("Warning: %d gene-based tests have infinite LOG10P values (p=0)", sum(is.infinite(gene_based_all$LOG10P))))
}
add_beta <- gene_based_all$BETA[gene_based_all$TEST == "ADD"]
if(length(add_beta) && any(is.finite(add_beta) & abs(add_beta) > 20)) {
  warning("Some ADD burden BETA values are very large (|BETA| > 20). Check Regenie column alignment (CHROM GENPOS ... BETA SE LOG10P).")
}

# REGENIE gene-based ID: GENE.MASK.<aaf_suffix> — suffix can contain dots (0.01, 0.001, …).
.regenie_split_gene_mask_thresh <- function(ids) {
  ids <- as.character(ids)
  n <- length(ids)
  g <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  m <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  tr <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    p <- strsplit(ids[i], ".", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
    if (length(p) < 3L) next
    g[i] <- p[[1L]]
    m[i] <- p[[2L]]
    tr[i] <- paste(p[seq.int(3L, length(p))], collapse = ".")
  }
  list(GENE = g, MASK = m, THRESH_RAW = tr)
}
gene_id_parts <- .regenie_split_gene_mask_thresh(gene_based_all$ID)
gene_based_all <- gene_based_all %>%
  mutate(
    GENE = gene_id_parts$GENE,
    MASK = gene_id_parts$MASK,
    THRESH_RAW = gene_id_parts$THRESH_RAW,
    THRESH = as.character(ifelse(THRESH_RAW == "all", "All variants", THRESH_RAW)),
    MAF_Filter = THRESH
  )

# BH within family: ADD alone; SKAT+SKATO together; any other TEST each alone
.bh_within <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0L) return(df)
  df %>%
    mutate(
      PVAL_ADJ = {
        ok <- is.finite(PVAL) & PVAL > 0 & PVAL <= 1
        out <- rep(NA_real_, n())
        if (any(ok)) out[ok] <- p.adjust(PVAL[ok], method = "BH")
        out
      },
      LOG10P_ADJ = -log10(PVAL_ADJ)
    )
}

gene_based_add <- gene_based_all %>% filter(TEST == "ADD") %>% .bh_within() %>% .add_or_ci()
gene_based_skat <- gene_based_all %>%
  filter(TEST %in% c("ADD-SKAT", "ADD-SKATO")) %>%
  .bh_within()
gene_based_other <- gene_based_all %>%
  filter(!TEST %in% c("ADD", "ADD-SKAT", "ADD-SKATO")) %>%
  group_by(TEST) %>%
  group_modify(~ .bh_within(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Archive table carries family-specific FDR (not one mega-BH across all TESTs)
gene_based_all <- bind_rows(gene_based_add, gene_based_skat, gene_based_other)
```

### Analysis summary

```{r summary-stats,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}

pheno_file <- paste0("data/final/", params$project_name, ".regenie.pheno.txt")
pheno <- read_delim(pheno_file, delim = " ", col_names = TRUE, trim_ws = TRUE)

# Build proper summary table with scalar values

             "Unique genes tested (all TEST rows)",
             "Unique genes tested (ADD only)"),
  Count = c(
    length(unique(pheno$IID)),
    sum(pheno$STATUS == 1),
    sum(pheno$STATUS == 0),
    nrow(single_variant),

    length(unique(gene_based_add$GENE))
  )
)

kable(summary_df, format = "html", col.names = c("Metric", "Count")) %>%
  .style_report_kable(font_size = 13, full_width = FALSE, gene_col = 1L)
```

### Quality metrics

```{r quality-metrics,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
# λ_GC from the same -log10(p) values the QQ plots draw (1 df, median χ²).
single_lambda <- .lambda_gc(.p_for_lambda(single_variant$LOG10P))
gene_lambda <- .lambda_gc(.p_for_lambda(gene_based_add$LOG10P))

# Simple quality metrics (burden ADD only for gene-based rows)
sig_add_or <- gene_based_add$OR[gene_based_add$PVAL_ADJ < 0.05 & is.finite(gene_based_add$OR)]
max_or_sig <- if (length(sig_add_or)) round(max(sig_add_or, na.rm = TRUE), 2) else NA_real_

quality_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
        "Significant Single-Variants (p < 2.5e-6)",
        "Significant Burden Tests (ADD, FDR < 0.05)",
        "Lambda GC (single-variant)",
        "Lambda GC (gene-based ADD, pooled across masks and bins)",
        "Max OR (FDR-significant ADD only)"
    ),
    Value = c(
        format(sum(single_variant$LOG10P > 5.60206, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ","),
        format(sum(gene_based_add$PVAL_ADJ < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ","),
        .fmt_lambda(single_lambda),
        .fmt_lambda(gene_lambda),
        ifelse(is.finite(max_or_sig), format(max_or_sig, nsmall = 2), "—")
    )
)

kable(quality_df, format = "html",
      col.names = c("Quality Metric", "Value")) %>%
    .style_report_kable(font_size = 13, full_width = FALSE, gene_col = 1L)
```

λ_GC = median(χ²) / 0.4549, with χ² = `qchisq(1 − p, df = 1)` from the reported −log10(p). Under the null the median test has −log10(p) = 0.301. That median is what λ_GC measures. The upper-right of a QQ is the tail.

The pooled gene-based number mixes every mask and AAF bin. The QQ strip labels match the rows below (same function, same p-values).

```{r lambda-by-bin,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
thresh_levels <- c("0.01", "0.001", "0.0001", "singleton", "All variants")
lam_bins <- gene_based_add %>%
  group_by(MASK, THRESH) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests = sum(is.finite(LOG10P) & LOG10P >= 0),
    lambda_gc = .lambda_gc(.p_for_lambda(LOG10P)),
    median_mlog10p = {
      pv <- .p_for_lambda(LOG10P)
      if (length(pv) < 10L) NA_real_ else -log10(median(pv))
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )
mask_levels <- c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4")
extra_mask <- setdiff(unique(as.character(lam_bins$MASK)), mask_levels)
extra_thresh <- setdiff(unique(as.character(lam_bins$THRESH)), thresh_levels)
lam_bins <- lam_bins %>%
  mutate(
    MASK = factor(as.character(MASK), levels = c(mask_levels, extra_mask)),
    THRESH = factor(as.character(THRESH), levels = c(thresh_levels, extra_thresh))
  ) %>%
  arrange(MASK, THRESH)

lam_view <- lam_bins %>%
  transmute(
    Mask = as.character(MASK),
    `AAF bin` = as.character(THRESH),
    Tests = format(n_tests, big.mark = ","),
    `λ_GC` = .fmt_lambda(lambda_gc),
    `Median −log10(p)` = ifelse(is.finite(median_mlog10p), sprintf("%.3f", median_mlog10p), "NA")
  )

cat("\n**Gene-based ADD λ_GC by mask and AAF bin** (null median −log10(p) = 0.301)\n\n")
print(
  knitr::kable(lam_view, format = "html") %>%
    .style_report_kable(font_size = 13, full_width = FALSE, gene_col = 1L)
)
```

## Single-variant results

Step 2 tests all variants in the annotation pgen; gene-based M1–M4 use only `regenie.annotation.txt` / `regenie.set.txt`.

### Significant variants

```{r significant-single,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
sig_log10p_thresh <- 5.60206  # ~2.5e-6 exome-wide

# HTML kable output must use results='asis' or knitr wraps it as verbatim (shows as `## <div...` text).
fmt_small_p <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(!is.finite(x), "",
    ifelse(x < 1e-4, formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2), format(round(x, 5), trim = TRUE))
  )
}

significant_variants <- single_variant %>%
  filter(!is.na(LOG10P), LOG10P > sig_log10p_thresh) %>%
  arrange(desc(LOG10P))

.annot_join <- function(ids_df) {
  # subset stats/annot for just these IDs (never load full mask table)
  stats <- .stats_for_ids(ids_df$ID)
  if (nrow(stats) == 0L) return(ids_df)
  ids_df %>% left_join(stats, by = "ID", suffix = c("", ".ann"))
}

if (nrow(significant_variants) == 0L) {
  cat("None above exome-wide threshold (LOG10P > ", sig_log10p_thresh, ").\n", sep = "")
  significant_variants_export <- significant_variants
} else {
  sig_joined <- .annot_join(significant_variants)
  sig_joined <- .fill_variant_carriers_from_afcc(sig_joined)
  if (!"Gene" %in% names(sig_joined)) sig_joined$Gene <- NA_character_
  if (!"HGVSc" %in% names(sig_joined)) sig_joined$HGVSc <- NA_character_
  if (!"HGVSp" %in% names(sig_joined)) sig_joined$HGVSp <- NA_character_
  if (!"ClinVar.SIG" %in% names(sig_joined)) sig_joined[["ClinVar.SIG"]] <- NA_character_
  if (!"AutoGVP" %in% names(sig_joined)) sig_joined$AutoGVP <- NA_character_
  if (!"n_case_carrier" %in% names(sig_joined)) sig_joined$n_case_carrier <- NA_integer_
  if (!"n_control_carrier" %in% names(sig_joined)) sig_joined$n_control_carrier <- NA_integer_

  sig_display <- sig_joined %>%
    mutate(
      Variant = paste0("chr", CHROM, ":", GENPOS, " ", REF, ">", ALT),
      Gene_lab = ifelse(is.na(Gene) | Gene == "", "—", as.character(Gene))
    ) %>%
    select(
      Variant, ID, Gene_lab, HGVSc, HGVSp, `ClinVar.SIG`, AutoGVP,
      n_case_carrier, n_control_carrier,
      A1FREQ, OR, OR_L95, OR_U95, LOG10P, PVAL, PVAL_ADJ
    ) %>%
    arrange(PVAL)

  significant_variants_export <- sig_display

  sig_view <- sig_display %>%
    mutate(PVAL = fmt_small_p(PVAL), PVAL_ADJ = fmt_small_p(PVAL_ADJ))

  knitr::kable(
    sig_view,
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    col.names = c(
      "Variant", "ID", "Gene", "HGVSc", "HGVSp", "ClinVar.SIG", "AutoGVP",
      "n case", "n ctrl",
      "Alt freq", "OR", "OR L95", "OR U95", "−log10(p)", "P", "FDR P"
    ),
    caption = paste0(
      "Exome-wide hits (n = ", nrow(sig_display),
      "). n case/ctrl = carriers from mask_variant_stats when available; ",
      "else ≈ alt allele count from REGENIE --af-cc (A1FREQ × 2 × N)."
    )
  ) %>%
    .style_report_kable(font_size = 12, full_width = TRUE, gene_col = 3L, scroll_h = "420px") %>%
    print()
}
```

### QQ plot

```{r qq-plot,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,fig.width=8,fig.height=7.5}
qq_data <- .qq_points(single_variant$LOG10P)
single_lambda <- .lambda_gc(.p_for_lambda(single_variant$LOG10P))
sv_p <- .p_for_lambda(single_variant$LOG10P)
sv_med <- if (length(sv_p) >= 10L) -log10(median(sv_p)) else NA_real_
qq_curve <- .qq_lambda_curve(nrow(qq_data), single_lambda)
qq_med <- .qq_median_row(qq_data)
qq_sub <- sprintf(
  "λ_GC = %s    median −log10(p) = %s (null 0.301)    n = %s\nDashed: null. Orange: every χ² multiplied by λ_GC. Diamond: median test.",
  .fmt_lambda(single_lambda),
  .fmt_lambda(sv_med),
  format(nrow(qq_data), big.mark = ",")
)
print(.plot_qq(
  qq_data, curve = qq_curve, med = qq_med,
  title = "Single-variant QQ",
  subtitle = qq_sub
))
qq_lim <- max(c(qq_data$expected, qq_data$observed), na.rm = TRUE)
if (is.finite(qq_lim) && qq_lim > 3.2) {
  print(.plot_qq(
    qq_data, curve = qq_curve, med = qq_med,
    title = "Single-variant QQ, median region",
    subtitle = "Same points and the same λ_GC, axes limited to 0–3 so the median is visible.",
    xlim = c(0, 3), ylim = c(0, 3)
  ))
}
```

The full plot is square so a slope of 1 is 45 degrees. λ_GC is the value in **Quality metrics**. The zoom is the region that determines it. Points that climb above the orange curve are the tail.

FDR is within family (ADD vs SKAT+SKATO).

### Burden (ADD) — summary by mask

```{r mask-summary,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
mask_summary <- gene_based_add %>%
  group_by(MASK) %>%
  summarize(
    Tests = n(),
    Significant_Tests = sum(PVAL_ADJ < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    Most_Significant_Gene = GENE[which.max(LOG10P)],
    Max_Log10P = max(pmin(LOG10P, 100), na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Beta = mean(BETA, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Significance_Rate = Significant_Tests / Tests * 100)

kable(mask_summary, format = "html", digits = 3,
      col.names = c("Mask", "Tests (gene×mask×threshold)", "FDR significant tests", "Top Gene", "Max −log10(P) (display cap 100)", "Mean Beta", "Significance Rate (%)")) %>%
  .style_report_kable(font_size = 13, full_width = FALSE, gene_col = 1L)
```

**Mask note:** `M4` is a negative-control mask built from synonymous variants only.
It explicitly excludes `M1/M2` variants and a blacklist of potential MNP-pair IDs that did not pass full validation, to reduce false-negative MNP contamination in controls.

**Gene×consequence excludes:** sites matching rules in `mask_gene_consequence_exclude.txt` are dropped from **all** masks at REGENIE preprocess (annotation/set). Current rule: **CHEK2 + missense_variant** (including compound VEP consequences that contain missense). Rationale: CHEK2 missense variants are not treated as disease-contributing in this analysis despite some AutoGVP likely-pathogenic calls. Dropped IDs are written to `data/regenie/mask_gene_consequence_excluded.csv`.

### Top genes by clinical category (burden ADD only)

**Sorted by:** gene ADD **−log10(P)** (highest first) within each mask × AAF bin.

**HTML:** top **10** genes for **0.01**, **0.001**, and **singleton**.

**CSV:** top **20** genes for **0.01, 0.001, 0.0001, singleton, All variants** (All variants is CSV-only, not shown in HTML).

| Bin | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| **0.01** | AAF ≤ 1% |
| **0.001** | AAF ≤ 0.1% |
| **0.0001** | AAF ≤ 0.01% (CSV) |
| **singleton** | MAC=1 sites burdened together — **not** single-variant GWAS |
| **All variants** | no AAF ceiling (CSV only) |

OR 95% CI = `exp(BETA ± 1.96×SE)`. Cases/Controls = unique samples carrying ≥1 mask variant in the gene (from prebuilt `*.report.gene_carriers.tsv`).

Prefer prebuilt tables from `regenie_build_report_tables.py` (`data/final/{project}.report.*.tsv`) when present — report only displays.

```{r topgenes-add-helper, include=FALSE}
HTML_THRESH <- c("0.01", "0.001", "singleton")
CSV_THRESH <- c("0.01", "0.001", "0.0001", "singleton", "All variants")

.qq_gene_add <- function(mask, threshs = HTML_THRESH) {
  # One QQ per AAF bin (ADD). λ_GC is the same median-χ² function as the quality table.
  dat <- gene_based_add %>%
    filter(MASK == mask, THRESH %in% threshs, is.finite(LOG10P), LOG10P >= 0) %>%
    mutate(THRESH = factor(as.character(THRESH), levels = threshs))
  if (nrow(dat) == 0L) {
    cat("_No ADD p-values for QQ: ", mask, "._\n\n", sep = "")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  lam <- dat %>%
    group_by(THRESH, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(
      n_tests = n(),
      lambda = .lambda_gc(.p_for_lambda(LOG10P)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_tests > 0L) %>%
    mutate(
      facet_lab = sprintf(
        "%s   n=%s   λ=%s",
        as.character(THRESH),
        format(n_tests, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
        .fmt_lambda(lambda)
      )
    )
  panel_levels <- lam$facet_lab[match(threshs, as.character(lam$THRESH))]
  panel_levels <- panel_levels[!is.na(panel_levels)]
  parts <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(lam)), function(i) {
    d <- dat %>% filter(as.character(THRESH) == as.character(lam$THRESH[i]))
    q <- .qq_points(d$LOG10P)
    q$facet_lab <- lam$facet_lab[i]
    q
  })
  qq <- bind_rows(parts) %>%
    mutate(facet_lab = factor(facet_lab, levels = panel_levels))
  curves <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(lam)), function(i) {
    cv <- .qq_lambda_curve(lam$n_tests[i], lam$lambda[i])
    if (!nrow(cv)) return(cv)
    cv$facet_lab <- factor(lam$facet_lab[i], levels = panel_levels)
    cv
  }))
  med <- .qq_median_row(qq)
  lim <- max(c(qq$expected, qq$observed), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(lim) || lim < 1) lim <- 1
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n**ADD burden QQ: %s.** λ_GC is the median χ² ratio for that bin (same number as the quality table). Dashed: null. Orange: χ² multiplied by that λ_GC. Diamond: median test.\n\n",
    mask
  ))
  print(.plot_qq(
    qq, curve = curves, med = med,
    title = paste0("Gene-based ADD QQ — ", mask)
  ))
  if (lim > 3.2) {
    print(.plot_qq(
      qq, curve = curves, med = med,
      title = paste0("Gene-based ADD QQ — ", mask, ", median region"),
      subtitle = "Same points and the same λ_GC, axes limited to 0–3.",
      xlim = c(0, 3), ylim = c(0, 3)
    ))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

regenie_topgenes_add_table <- function(mask, thresh, n = 10L) {
  if (!is.null(report_top_genes) && nrow(report_top_genes) > 0) {
    tab <- report_top_genes %>%
      filter(MASK == mask, THRESH == thresh) %>%
      arrange(rank) %>%
      slice_head(n = n) %>%
      select(GENE, MASK, THRESH, BETA, SE, OR, OR_L95, OR_U95, LOG10P, PVAL, PVAL_ADJ)
  } else {
    tab <- gene_based_add %>%
      filter(MASK == mask, THRESH == thresh) %>%
      slice_max(LOG10P, n = n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      select(GENE, MASK, THRESH, BETA, SE, OR, OR_L95, OR_U95, LOG10P, PVAL, PVAL_ADJ) %>%
      arrange(desc(LOG10P))
  }
  if (nrow(tab) == 0L) return(invisible(NULL))
  carr <- report_gene_carriers %>%
    filter(MASK == mask, THRESH == thresh) %>%
    select(GENE, Cases = n_case_carriers, Controls = n_control_carriers)
  tab <- tab %>%
    left_join(carr, by = "GENE") %>%
    transmute(
      Gene = GENE,
      Cases, Controls,
      Beta = BETA, SE, OR, `OR L95` = OR_L95, `OR U95` = OR_U95,
      `-log10(P)` = LOG10P, P = PVAL, `FDR P` = PVAL_ADJ
    )
  cat(sprintf("\n**Top %d genes by ADD −log10(P): %s — %s**\n\n", n, mask, thresh))
  knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
    .style_report_kable(font_size = 13, full_width = FALSE, gene_col = 1L)
}
```

### Variants in burden masks for top genes (ADD)

Snplist-exact membership from `data/regenie/chr*.step2_gene_based_masks.snplist`. HTML: top 10 × 0.01/0.001/singleton. CSV: top 20 × 0.01/0.001/0.0001/singleton/All variants.

```{r variant-contrib-helper, include=FALSE}
top_genes_for <- function(mask, thresh, n = 10L) {
  if (!is.null(report_top_genes) && nrow(report_top_genes) > 0) {
    return(
      report_top_genes %>%
        filter(MASK == mask, THRESH == thresh) %>%
        arrange(rank) %>%
        slice_head(n = n) %>%
        transmute(
          GENE,
          gene_LOG10P = LOG10P,
          gene_PVAL_ADJ = PVAL_ADJ,
          gene_BETA = BETA,
          gene_OR = OR,
          gene_OR_L95 = OR_L95,
          gene_OR_U95 = OR_U95,
          gene_A1FREQ = A1FREQ,
          gene_A1FREQ_CASES = A1FREQ_CASES,
          gene_A1FREQ_CONTROLS = A1FREQ_CONTROLS
        )
    )
  }
  gene_based_add %>%
    filter(MASK == mask, THRESH == thresh) %>%
    slice_max(LOG10P, n = n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(desc(LOG10P)) %>%
    transmute(
      GENE,
      gene_LOG10P = LOG10P,
      gene_PVAL_ADJ = PVAL_ADJ,
      gene_BETA = BETA,
      gene_OR = OR,
      gene_OR_L95 = OR_L95,
      gene_OR_U95 = OR_U95,
      gene_A1FREQ = A1FREQ,
      gene_A1FREQ_CASES = A1FREQ_CASES,
      gene_A1FREQ_CONTROLS = A1FREQ_CONTROLS
    )
}

.enrich_ids <- function(df) {
  stats <- .stats_for_ids(df$ID)
  if (nrow(stats) == 0L) return(df)
  keep <- intersect(names(stats), c(
    "ID", "Gene", "Variant.LoF_level", "Variant.Class", "Variant.Consequence",
    "HGVSc", "HGVSp", "ClinVar.SIG", "AutoGVP",
    "n_case_carrier", "n_control_carrier", "AF", "AC"
  ))
  df %>% left_join(stats %>% select(all_of(keep)), by = "ID")
}

contrib_table <- function(mask, thresh, n = 10L) {
  if (!is.null(report_contrib) && nrow(report_contrib) > 0) {
    tg <- top_genes_for(mask, thresh, n)
    if (nrow(tg) == 0L) return(tibble())
    return(
      report_contrib %>%
        filter(MASK == mask, THRESH == thresh, GENE %in% tg$GENE) %>%
        arrange(desc(gene_LOG10P), GENE, ID)
    )
  }
  tg <- top_genes_for(mask, thresh, n)
  if (nrow(tg) == 0L || nrow(mask_snplist) == 0L) return(tibble())
  mem <- mask_snplist %>%
    filter(MASK == mask, THRESH == thresh, GENE %in% tg$GENE) %>%
    select(GENE, ID, MASK, THRESH)
  if (nrow(mem) == 0L) return(tibble())
  mem %>%
    left_join(tg, by = "GENE") %>%
    .enrich_ids() %>%
    arrange(desc(gene_LOG10P), GENE, ID)
}

contrib_consequence_matrix <- function(mask, thresh, tab) {
  # Split VEP compound consequences on &; each atom gets +1 (e.g. missense&splice → both)
  if (nrow(tab) == 0L || !"Variant.Consequence" %in% names(tab)) return(tibble())
  rows <- tab %>%
    filter(!is.na(Variant.Consequence), Variant.Consequence != "", Variant.Consequence != ".") %>%
    select(GENE, cons = Variant.Consequence)
  if (nrow(rows) == 0L) return(tibble())
  rows %>%
    mutate(atom = strsplit(as.character(cons), "&", fixed = TRUE)) %>%
    tidyr::unnest_longer(atom) %>%
    mutate(atom = trimws(atom)) %>%
    filter(nzchar(atom)) %>%
    count(GENE, atom, name = "n") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = atom, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
}

render_contrib <- function(mask, thresh, n = 10L) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="regenie-block-sep"><p style="margin:0 0 0.4rem 0; font-weight:600;">%s — %s</p></div>\n',
    mask, thresh
  ))
  tab <- contrib_table(mask, thresh, n = n)
  if (nrow(tab) == 0L) {
    cat("_No snplist variants for ", mask, " — ", thresh, "._\n\n", sep = "")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (!"HGVSc" %in% names(tab)) tab$HGVSc <- NA_character_
  if (!"HGVSp" %in% names(tab)) tab$HGVSp <- NA_character_
  if (!"Variant.Consequence" %in% names(tab)) tab$Variant.Consequence <- NA_character_
  if (!"ClinVar.SIG" %in% names(tab)) tab[["ClinVar.SIG"]] <- NA_character_
  if (!"AutoGVP" %in% names(tab)) tab$AutoGVP <- NA_character_
  if (!"n_case_carrier" %in% names(tab)) tab$n_case_carrier <- NA_integer_
  if (!"n_control_carrier" %in% names(tab)) tab$n_control_carrier <- NA_integer_

  show <- tab %>%
    transmute(
      Gene = GENE, ID, HGVSc, HGVSp,
      Consequence = .fmt_consequence_label(Variant.Consequence),
      `ClinVar.SIG`, AutoGVP,
      n_case = n_case_carrier, n_ctrl = n_control_carrier,
      `Gene -log10(P)` = round(gene_LOG10P, 3),
      `Gene FDR` = signif(gene_PVAL_ADJ, 3),
      `Gene OR` = gene_OR
    )
  cat(sprintf(
    "\n**Mask variants (snplist): %s — %s** (top %d genes by ADD −log10(P))\n\n",
    mask, thresh, n
  ))
  print(
    knitr::kable(show, format = "html", digits = 4) %>%
      .style_report_kable(font_size = 12, full_width = TRUE, gene_col = 1L, scroll_h = "360px")
  )

  cat('<div style="height:1.6rem;"></div>\n')
  mx <- contrib_consequence_matrix(mask, thresh, tab)
  if (nrow(mx) > 0) {
    cons_cols <- setdiff(names(mx), "GENE")
    if (length(cons_cols)) {
      names(mx)[names(mx) %in% cons_cols] <- .fmt_consequence_header(cons_cols)
    }
    names(mx)[names(mx) == "GENE"] <- "Gene"
    cat(sprintf("\n**Consequence counts: %s — %s**\n\n", mask, thresh))
    cat("Compound VEP terms split on `&`; each term counted.\n\n")
    print(
      knitr::kable(mx, format = "html") %>%
        .style_report_kable(
          font_size = 12, full_width = TRUE, gene_col = 1L,
          header_wrap = TRUE, scroll_h = "320px"
        )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r suggestive-genes,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
  group_by(MASK) %>%
  slice_max(LOG10P, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

suggestive_genes <- top_by_raw_p %>%
  filter(LOG10P > 3, PVAL_ADJ >= 0.05) %>%

  slice_head(n = 15) %>%

  .join_gene_carriers() %>%

if(nrow(suggestive_genes) > 0) {
```

### CHEK2 (ADD)

Gene-level ADD burden for **M1 (pathogenic) only**, then M1 snplist variants with HGVSc/p and case/control **carrier** counts. M2/M3/M4 CHEK2 results are omitted here for now.

**Note:** CHEK2 **missense** sites are excluded from all masks upstream (`mask_gene_consequence_exclude.txt`), so they should not appear in this snplist table.

```{r chek2-analysis, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
.load_snplist_for_gene <- function(gene) {
  files <- Sys.glob("data/regenie/chr*.step2_gene_based_masks.snplist")
  if (!length(files)) return(tibble())
  prefix <- paste0(gene, ".")
  rows <- list()
  for (fp in files) {
    lines <- readLines(fp, warn = FALSE)
    for (ln in lines) {
      ln <- trimws(ln)
      if (!nzchar(ln) || startsWith(ln, "#") || !startsWith(ln, prefix)) next
      parts <- strsplit(ln, "\t", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      if (length(parts) < 2L) next
      mid <- parts[[1]]
      vids <- strsplit(parts[[2]], ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      vids <- vids[nzchar(vids)]
      if (!length(vids)) next
      sp <- strsplit(mid, ".", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      if (length(sp) < 3L) next
      thr_raw <- paste(sp[seq.int(3L, length(sp))], collapse = ".")
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- tibble(
        GENE = sp[[1]], MASK = sp[[2]],
        THRESH = ifelse(thr_raw == "all", "All variants", thr_raw),
        ID = vids
      )
    }
  }
  if (!length(rows)) return(tibble())
  bind_rows(rows)
}
```

### SKAT and SKATO — non-directional supporting tests (no OR)

These tests ask whether rare variants in a gene associate with disease **without** assuming a shared effect direction. Mixed risk/protective effects can still produce a small p-value. **There is no signed BETA/OR to interpret as risk vs protective** — use ADD burden for direction.

FDR (`PVAL_ADJ`) here is Benjamini–Hochberg among SKAT+SKATO rows only.

**Cases/Controls** = unique samples carrying ≥1 variant in that gene’s mask snplist (same definition as ADD top-gene tables). REGENIE’s own `N_CASES`/`N_CONTROLS` are cohort sizes in the model (nearly constant) and are not shown.

```{r gene-based-skat-skato-top, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
.fmt_small_p <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  ifelse(!is.finite(x), "",
    ifelse(x < 1e-4, formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2), format(round(x, 5), trim = TRUE))
  )
}

if (!is.null(report_top_skat) && nrow(report_top_skat) > 0) {
  skat_skato <- report_top_skat %>%
    arrange(PVAL_ADJ, desc(LOG10P)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30L) %>%
    select(any_of(c("GENE", "TEST", "MASK", "THRESH", "PVAL", "PVAL_ADJ", "LOG10P")))
} else {
  skat_skato <- gene_based_skat %>%
    arrange(PVAL_ADJ, PVAL) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30L) %>%
    select(GENE, TEST, MASK, THRESH, PVAL, PVAL_ADJ, LOG10P)
}

if (nrow(skat_skato) == 0L) {
  cat("_No SKAT/SKATO rows found (`TEST` in `ADD-SKAT`, `ADD-SKATO`). Confirm gene-based Step 2 outputs include those tests._\n")
} else {
  skat_view <- skat_skato %>%
    .join_gene_carriers() %>%
    mutate(
      PVAL = .fmt_small_p(PVAL),
      PVAL_ADJ = .fmt_small_p(PVAL_ADJ)
    ) %>%
    select(GENE, TEST, MASK, THRESH, Cases, Controls, PVAL, PVAL_ADJ, LOG10P)

  knitr::kable(
    skat_view,
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    col.names = c(
      "Gene", "Test", "Mask", "MAF filter", "Cases", "Controls",
      "P-value", "FDR P-value", "−log10(P)"
    ),
    caption = "Top SKAT/SKATO signals (FDR within SKAT+SKATO only). Cases/Controls = unique mask carriers. No OR."
  ) %>%
    .style_report_kable(font_size = 12, full_width = TRUE, gene_col = 1L, scroll_h = "480px") %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(c(7, 8, 9), extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%
    print()
}
```

## Directional burden (ADD)

### Risk-increasing genes (Beta > 0, FDR < 0.05)

```{r risk-genes,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
risk_genes <- gene_based_add %>%
  filter(PVAL_ADJ < 0.05, BETA > 0) %>%
  select(GENE, MASK, THRESH, BETA, PVAL_ADJ) %>%
  arrange(PVAL_ADJ) %>%
  .join_gene_carriers() %>%
  select(GENE, MASK, THRESH, Cases, Controls, BETA, PVAL_ADJ)

if(nrow(risk_genes) > 0) {
    kable(risk_genes,
          format = "html", digits = 4,
          col.names = c("Gene", "Mask", "MAF Filter", "Cases", "Controls", "Beta", "FDR P-value")) %>%
      .style_report_kable(font_size = 12, full_width = FALSE, gene_col = 1L) %>%
      column_spec(c(6, 7), color = "red")
} else {
    cat("No risk-increasing gene associations found")
}
```

### Protective genes (Beta < 0, FDR < 0.05)

```{r protective-genes,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
protective_genes <- gene_based_add %>%
  filter(PVAL_ADJ < 0.05, BETA < 0) %>%
  select(GENE, MASK, THRESH, BETA, PVAL_ADJ) %>%
  arrange(PVAL_ADJ) %>%
  .join_gene_carriers() %>%
  select(GENE, MASK, THRESH, Cases, Controls, BETA, PVAL_ADJ)

if(nrow(protective_genes) > 0) {
    kable(protective_genes,
          format = "html", digits = 4,
          col.names = c("Gene", "Mask", "MAF Filter", "Cases", "Controls", "Beta", "FDR P-value")) %>%
      .style_report_kable(font_size = 12, full_width = FALSE, gene_col = 1L) %>%
      column_spec(c(6, 7), color = "steelblue")
} else {
    cat("No protective gene associations found")
}
```

```{r save-results,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
}

cat("**Analysis completed on:**", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
```

## Appendix: `--minMAC` — single-variant vs gene-based

This run uses **`--minMAC 1`** in both Step 2 single-variant and Step 2 gene-based (**REGENIE’s default is 5**; earlier comparison runs used **10**). The flag does **not** mean the same thing in both analyses.

### Single-variant Step 2

- `--minMAC` filters **each tested site**.
- With `--minMAC 10`, sites with MAC &lt; 10 are **not tested** and do not appear in the single-variant `.regenie` files.
- With `--minMAC 1`, almost every polymorphic site is tested (only monomorphic / MAC 0 drop out).
- Effect on the report: many more ultra-rare tests → noisier QQ / higher genomic inflation (λ). That is expected; it does not by itself mean the null model is broken.
- SPA / Firth approximations are also less well calibrated for MAC ≲ 5–10, so some extra inflation under `--minMAC 1` is expected.

### Gene-based Step 2 (burden / SKAT / SKATO)

- Individual rare sites are still allowed into masks (AAF bins / singleton bin decide **which** sites enter which mask).
- `--minMAC` then filters the **collapsed mask genotype**, not each constituent variant.
- REGENIE’s log wording is along the lines of: masks with MAC below the threshold are ignored.
- A gene can still be tested even if every site in the mask is a singleton or doubleton, as long as the finished mask (the number of samples carrying at least one qualifying variant) has MAC ≥ `--minMAC`.

**Practical example of the confusion:** people count “4 case carriers + 1 control carrier” across several ultra-rare sites in a gene and ask why that gene appears when they are thinking “minMAC 10 per variant.” Answer: gene-based minMAC is on the **mask**, and those carriers can accumulate across different rare sites. Single-variant minMAC 10 would have dropped each of those sites from the per-site GWAS, but they can still contribute to the gene mask.

### Related knobs (not the same as minMAC)

| Knob | Role |
|------|------|
| `--aaf-bins` | Upper AAF cutoffs for building separate masks (e.g. 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001). |
| **singleton** mask | Separate burden of MAC=1 sites (REGENIE always builds this with aaf-bins). **Not** the same as single-variant GWAS. |
| `--build-mask max` | How dosages collapse across sites in a gene (max ALT across sites per sample). |
| `--vc-tests skat,skato` | Extra non-directional tests on the same masks; no OR / direction. |
| `--vc-MACthr` | **Different** from `--minMAC`. Default **10**. See below. |

### `--vc-MACthr` (SKAT-family only — we have not changed this)

REGENIE default is **`--vc-MACthr 10`**. Our runs leave that default alone.

It applies **only** when `--vc-tests` runs SKAT / SKATO / ACAT-type tests. It does **not** change the ADD burden test (`TEST == ADD`), which already collapses every site in the mask via `--build-mask`.

**What it does (REGENIE docs):**  
Within each gene mask for a VC test, ultra-rare sites with **MAC ≤ `--vc-MACthr`** are **collapsed into one internal burden component**. That single collapsed genotype is what enters the SKAT/ACAT machinery **instead of** treating each ultra-rare site as its own term. Sites with MAC above the threshold stay as individual contributors to the VC test.

**Default 10 means:** under the default of 10, nearly all sites in a typical rare-variant mask are collapsed into one internal component before SKAT is run. SKAT therefore sees mostly that one aggregate rare-burden term plus any less-rare sites that remain.

**Lowering `--vc-MACthr` (e.g. toward 1):**  
- Fewer sites qualify as “ultra-rare” for collapsing.  
- More individual rare variants enter SKAT as separate terms.  
- SKAT becomes more “per-site variance” and less dependent on a single collapsed ultra-rare component.  
- Can change which genes look strong on SKAT/SKATO **without** changing ADD results.  
- Same calibration caveat as low-MAC singles: very rare per-site terms are noisy.

**Raising `--vc-MACthr`:**  
- More collapsing into the single collapsed ultra-rare component.  
- SKAT leans even more on one aggregate rare-burden direction within the VC model.

**If the goal is to retain ultra-rare signal in the gene-based results:**

| Knob | What it filters / collapses | Affects ADD? | Affects SKAT/SKATO? |
|------|------------------------------|--------------|---------------------|
| `--minMAC` (gene-based) | Finished **mask** MAC (test or drop the whole mask) | Yes | Yes (whether that mask is tested at all) |
| `--minMAC` (single-variant) | Each **site** | N/A | N/A |
| `--vc-MACthr` | Inside a VC test: which **sites** are collapsed into an ultra-rare component vs kept separate | **No** | **Yes** |

- `--minMAC` controls whether a low-MAC mask is tested at all (affects both ADD and SKAT).
- `--vc-MACthr` only changes how SKAT treats the rare sites inside a mask that already passed the minMAC filter. It does not alter ADD results and does not affect single-variant inflation.
- We left `--vc-MACthr` at its default of 10. SKAT results therefore reflect the software’s standard collapsing behavior.

### What “Cases / Controls” mean in this report

- **Gene tables** (top ADD, suggestive, SKAT, risk/protective): unique samples carrying ≥1 variant in that gene×mask×bin snplist (from `*.report.gene_carriers.tsv`).
- **Variant tables** (mask contrib, CHEK2 sites): per-site carriers from `mask_variant_stats.tsv` when available.
- **Single-variant hits:** prefer mask-stats carriers; if missing (site not in the LoF/syn mask-stats set), approximate alt allele count from REGENIE `--af-cc` (`A1FREQ × 2 × N`), which for rare hets is ≈ carrier count.
- REGENIE’s own `N_CASES` / `N_CONTROLS` columns are **cohort sizes in the model** (nearly constant) — not “how many people carry the variant,” so we do not use those as the collaborator-facing carrier columns.
